apps.name: Tip Calculator
apps.description: Calculate tips and split any bill with friends in seconds. Enter the amount, pick a tip percentage and number of people, and see exactly what each person pays. Works offline, with no sign-up.

apps.name: Prompt Book: AI Video Prompts
apps.description: A free Android app with a library of ready-to-use prompts for AI video and image generators, organised by niche. Search, save favourites, copy a prompt and open it in ChatGPT or Claude.
